records.name: Babyface Ehrlichdoch
records.biography_en: Wants to do the right thing before anyone explains which side is selling it. His medal promises that HyperNorm goodness can be identified before the act. A dissonant card asks for help without first choosing a side. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die gute Absicht wartet auf ihre richtige Zuordnung.

variant_notes.note_en: Wants to do the right thing before anyone explains which side is selling it.

records.name: Heel Ganzbestimmt
records.biography_en: Enjoys being the problem until the audience asks him to stay in character. His HyperNorm belt rewards being the necessary villain. A dissonant card asks whether he is allowed to be kind when the audience expects the opposite. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Rolle sieht eine freundliche Abweichung nicht vor.

variant_notes.note_en: Enjoys being the problem until the audience asks him to stay in character.

records.name: Schiedsrichter Grauzone
records.biography_en: Can see both sides clearly enough to delay the decision indefinitely. His grey HyperNorm flag postpones decisions under the name of balance. A dissonant card asks who must keep waiting while he considers both sides. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Ausgewogenheit verlängert vorläufig die Zuständigkeit.

variant_notes.note_en: Can see both sides clearly enough to delay the decision indefinitely.

records.name: Weichenstellerin Dennoch
records.biography_en: Has been handed two options and would like to ask who built the track. Her HyperNorm lever permits two approved answers and no questions about the track. A dissonant card asks who restricted the choice before she arrived. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Wahlmöglichkeit wurde bereits vor ihrer Übergabe begrenzt.

variant_notes.note_en: Has been handed two options and would like to ask who built the track.

records.name: Engelteufel Sowohlals
records.biography_en: Finds the moral conflict easier when both voices are using his mouth. His HyperNorm halo and horn debate which voice deserves sole ownership. A dissonant card asks whether an ordinary mixed feeling needs a winner. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die innere Einigkeit bleibt mit zwei Stimmen beschlussfähig.

variant_notes.note_en: Finds the moral conflict easier when both voices are using his mouth.

records.name: Komitee-Eule Abgewogen
records.biography_en: Requests another hearing to determine whether anyone has yet been heard. Her HyperNorm book records hearings held to confirm that consultation occurred. A dissonant card asks whether anyone altered the conclusion after listening. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Anhörung wird um die Prüfung des Gehörten erweitert.

variant_notes.note_en: Requests another hearing to determine whether anyone has yet been heard.
